name: dy-gestion-reclamos-web
description: Sistema Monorepo de Gestión y Automatización de Reclamos Web - Don Yeyo S.A.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client

author: Don Yeyo S.A.
